'''Michael W. Binger''' (born December 20, 1976, in [[Delray Beach, Florida]]) is a part-time professional [[poker]] player, based in [[Atherton, California|Atherton]], [[California]]. He has a brother, Nick Binger, who also has several high-profile tournament cashes.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://news.bluffmagazine.com/michael-and-nick-binger-same-genes-different-games-3888/ |title=Michael and Nick Binger: Same Genes, Different Games &#124; BLUFF Poker News |accessdate=2011-02-06 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120714072051/http://news.bluffmagazine.com/michael-and-nick-binger-same-genes-different-games-3888/ |archivedate=July 14, 2012 |df=mdy-all }}</ref>

Binger graduated from [[North Carolina State University]] before receiving a [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in [[theoretical physics]] from [[Stanford University]] in 2006. Just two months after receiving his PhD, he outlasted 8,770 players in the [[2006 World Series of Poker]] (WSOP) $10,000 [[Betting (poker)#No limit|No limit]] [[Texas Hold'em]] Main Event, finishing third and earning $4,123,310. Binger had reached a final table earlier in that year's WSOP, finishing sixth.

Since the 2006 WSOP, Binger has finished in the money of six [[World Poker Tour]] events. At the [[2007 World Series of Poker|2007 WSOP]], Binger tied [[Chris Ferguson]], [[Phil Hellmuth]] and [[Humberto Brenes]] for second most cashes of any player in a single [[World Series of Poker]] season with eight. This included a final table appearance in [[2007 World Series of Poker results#Event 22|Event 22]] a $5,000 buy-in No limit Texas Hold'em tournament (finishing 3rd) won by [[James Mackey (poker player)|James Mackey]].

Binger won the 2008 [[WSOP Circuit Event]] – Lake Tahoe, $5,150 Championship, earning $181,379

As of 2019, his total live tournament winnings exceed $7,000,000, most of which ($5,167,037) have come at the WSOP.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mike Binger's profile on The Hendon Mob |url=https://pokerdb.thehendonmob.com/player.php?a=r&n=38719 |access-date=2023-12-22 |website=The Hendon Mob Poker Database |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Michael Binger |url=https://www.wsop.com/players/profile/?playerID=14985 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220095702/https://www.wsop.com/players/profile/?playerID=14985 |archive-date=2025-02-20 |access-date=2025-06-26 |website=[[World Series of Poker|WSOP.com]]}}</ref>
